summary: Cred and Duck discuss the ongoing market rotation from meme coins to 'useful' assets like DeFi tokens and boomer coins. They note Bitcoin is heavily supported by Saylor's aggressive buying around 100K levels, which has created a bailout dynamic for altcoin traders. The hosts are bullish on their Hyperliquid and XRP positions while noting Solana has underperformed recently after being the cycle darling. They express strong criticism of the meme coin KOL industrial complex while acknowledging DeFi and ETH ecosystem tokens are currently outperforming.
key_takeaways: MicroStrategy/Saylor is the dominant price-insensitive BTC buyer, providing floor around 100K
Rotation from meme coins to DeFi and boomer coins represents a narrative shift that may extend cycle longevity
Altcoin leverage is extremely high with no resilience on dips - biggest liquidation day since 2021 recently
Take profits and reduce leverage as portfolio grows - hedge against your own stupidity
Late rotation into already-pumped assets (like SOL now) typically results in underperformance
